audience: small businesses reviewing accounting, customer and stock records in Collmex

useCases.title: Review overdue balances
useCases.text: Read open customer or supplier items with due dates, days overdue and outstanding amounts to decide which balances need attention.

useCases.title: Check stock before quoting
useCases.text: Look up a product and its available stock, accounting for demand due today or earlier. Service products may have no stock quantity.

useCases.title: Review a customer order
useCases.text: Find sales orders by customer, order number or date range and review their status and positions. This does not change fulfillment or accounting.

useCases.title: Create a customer after checking for duplicates
useCases.text: Search for the customer first, then create a new record with the requested company or person details. Collmex assigns a new customer number; no message is sent.
